newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli panel to weigh secondary mortgage market.
newsitem.headline: Israeli panel to weigh secondary mortgage market.

text.p: Israeli Finance Minister Dan Meridor said on Wednesday that he had appointed a committee to explore setting up a secondary mortgage market.
Meridor said the panel, to be headed by treasury accountant-general Shai Talomon, would use the U.S. market as its model and explore issues relating to legislation, taxes, insurance and guarantees.
The committee has three months to make recommendations.

The Treasury has mulled the idea of a secondary mortgage market for many years and in October the Brodet committee on capital market reform recommended the idea as a way of increasing funds available for home loan finance and lowering mortgage rates.
